summary: Master Cloud Security and Secure Cloud Migration with our training course. Equip yourself with essential skills for safeguarding cloud environments.
lede: Cloud security training helps migration, infrastructure, and technology-risk professionals assess workloads and plan controlled cloud moves. Learners practise building risk registers and readiness assessments, designing least-privilege access, reviewing landing-zone safeguards, mapping shared responsibilities, and setting migration security gates alongside logging, recovery, and control validation.
audienceIntro: This foundation-to-intermediate course is designed for professionals who contribute to cloud workload protection, migration governance, architecture, infrastructure delivery, or technology risk. It suits people who need a practical control framework and migration artefacts rather than provider-specific certification preparation.
modules: Cloud Security Foundations and Shared Responsibility
Cloud Migration Risk and Readiness Assessment
Data Protection and Cloud Workload Security
Secure Migration Roadmap and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: You need practical exposure to at least one technology environment or security process. Familiarity with identity management, network controls, logging, risk registers, or application delivery will help you contribute effectively. You do not need to write code or hold a cloud certification. Advanced provider-specific deployment and production automation remain outside the course scope.
